notes.title: Yippy Cube demo is avaliable!
notes.notes:
Hey, there

We’re still working hard on Yippy Cube! I’m excited to announce that Yippy Cube is part of The GWB Game Awards 2022! 

To celebrate we’ll be setting the Yippy Cube demo live until the 21th on Steam! 
Try it out with your friends! If you enjoy Yippy Cube, do not forget to add it to your wishlist! 

-Yippy Panda

notes.title: Yippy Cubde has finished the alpha test
notes.notes:
Greetings players，

We’d like to inform you that the alpha test of Yippy Cube has ended this afternoon, and our service will be shut down at 10 AM on March 28. we’ll delete all game data at the same time, and the codes will be disabled.

Your feedback and bug report we are already been received. We will solve these problems and continue to improve our game.

Those who provided major bugs and excellent advice in the alpha test will get codes after Yippy Cube release. Here is the list.

AnkhSpirit 
Do✘ 
苍天鸭 
Lingyue 
敛散 
鲨士比亚    

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Yippy Cube Demo Complated!
notes.notes:
Hello guys：
    We have made a multiplayer cooperative happy party game.
    Cute animals are living a happy life in the kingdom of fantasy. But one day, odd cubes fall down from the sky. They will destroy the kingdom if animals leave them alone.
    But quickly, animals found the cubes will crash to dust if they put them in some spacial shapes. What a wonderful way to save their kingdom~
    Call your freind , helping you to save the kingdom as cute animals!
    The game is very easy to play. You just need to pick up cubes----roll the cubes----and place cubes ,fill the shapes.That all you have to do!
    But your freinds may do some troubles for you by place the cubes anywhere. But whatever,just throw the cubes on their head to crush them!Ah ,by the way ,becareful , because you will be crushed by the fallen cubes anytime either!
    Come to Yippy Cube, test and verify your freindship and maybe......love.
    There is no complicated battle, no brain burned number, no dark and heavy stories.All we have and all we need is happiness！To------gether！
    Now we have complate the first demo! If you are interested in our game .Please leave your message down to get the testing code.Let's happy!
    We will ajust the gameplay and add more interesting thinig by collecting your opinions!
